verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only indirect natural-language operation. MCP-compatible agents can discover payable services through tool calls on the Bazaar MCP server. Bazaar search accepts intent-style queries ranked by relevance, and agentic wallets let an agent discover and pay for services. A user could therefore drive discovery and payment through an LLM agent, but the product itself has no documented natural-language command interface. Missing for 10: a first-party natural-language command interface for operating the product (e.g., configuring payments or managing the facilitator via plain-English prompts), MCP or tool coverage beyond discovery, and hands-on corroboration of natural-language-driven workflows.
